definitions.explanation: A general term for various grains other than rice, wheat, and major staple crops. Includes millet (あわ、きび、ひえ), buckwheat, barley, quinoa, and other minor cereals. In modern usage, often refers to multi-grain blends sold as health foods.

examples.japanese: {雑穀|ざっこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{白米|はくまい}→白米：06101_hakumai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑穀|ざっこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: I cook white rice mixed with grains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑穀|ざっこく}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to mixed-grain rice for my health.

notes:
In modern Japan, {雑穀|ざっこく} is strongly associated with health food. Pre-mixed {雑穀|ざっこく} blends (often labeled {十六穀|じゅうろっこく} or {五穀|ごこく}) are popular products added to white rice for extra nutrition and texture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑穀|ざっこく}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: mixed-grain rice
- {雑穀|ざっこく}{米|まい}: multi-grain rice
- {雑穀|ざっこく}⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: multigrain bread
- {雑穀|ざっこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to mix in grains

RELATED WORDS:
- {五穀|ごこく}: five grains — traditional grouping of staple cereals
- ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧: brown rice — unpolished rice
- ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧: barley, wheat — common grain
- あわ: foxtail millet
- きび: proso millet
- ひえ: Japanese millet
